notes.title: N-Age Online: Awakening 2nd Anniversary Celebration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/6ef8a4c8bc5fdeaebc842aa769fc41efe92e1554.jpg[/img]

Greetings Students!

Welcome to the 2nd Anniversary Celebration of N-Age Online: Awakening! Today marks a special moment as we celebrate the amazing memories, epic battles, and strong bonds we've built together throughout the journey. This event is our way of showing deep appreciation to each of you for being an essential part of the N-Age story.

Let's hop into the 2nd anniversary updates!

[b]■ Patch Content:[/b]
➤ Lucky Box icon modification
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/ac0720d0b125aa7bb4e464c73941185c28bbec5c.png[/img]

➤ Carrying out work to improve the stabilization of the server

[b]■ Update:[/b]
➤ Wing animation has been added to the wing equipment, which has an enhancement level of +10 and above.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/1f8070f28675b5c7dbd14c23663cb99d80f82324.gif[/img]

➤ Summer Theme update will be implemented in Bourbon and Liberty maps.
➤ WSS Lucky Roulette update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b161d4863ff0cbbd8c0b52cb0f015d406173dcec.png[/img]

➤ Hip-hop concept costume set
➤ Hip-hop concept board mount
➤ [Royal] SP Hair

[b]■ Events[/b]
➤ Anniversary Hot-Time Event
Event Duration: May 30 - June 1, 2025, and June 6 - 8, 2025
Time: 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM GMT+7 (12 hours every day)
[list]
[*] EXP Boost +100%
[*] Fame EXP Boost +50%
[*] Durability Consumption -20%
[*] Skill EXP Boost +50%
[*] AP +20%
[/list]
➤ Field Hunting Event
Required Level: Level 50 or above
[list]
[*] Go to Borbon Fountain Square and look for the Chorangi NPC (X: 242 Y:424)
[*] Click Mission to activate the event.
[/list]

[b]NOTE: Make sure to accept the Anniversary Event mission for the event items to drop.[/b]

➤ Gift Exchange Event
[list]
[*] Collect 1 million gold coins and x5 Quest Cards and exchange them for a Thank You Gift Box.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/3c50d23c39606a5fd53b3b18e4e40136591fd0ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/7612bda9d552bebe425ef1174665ca450528e32c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/64aaf98e5924970ac2db37561eac7e63b36e5bc6.png[/img]

➤ Boss Monster Assault Event

Period: After maintenance on May 27, 2025 – Before maintenance on June 24, 2025
Required Level:100 and above

[list]
[*] During the event period, the boss monster "Intrusion Justice" will appear in Cinder Square, and defeating it will drop various rewards.
[*] You can receive the Intrusion Justice hunting event quest from the Blue Verti NPC (X:242 Y:430) in Bourbon Village.
[/list]
Completing the quest is required to receive additional rewards.

➤ Returning User Event
[b]Period:[/b] After maintenance on May 27, 2025 – Before maintenance on June 24, 2025
[b]Eligible Returning Users:[/b] Users who have not logged in for at least 14 days (latest logout date must be before May 13, 2025)
Rewards: 

[b]NOTE: Only the first character to log in per account will receive the reward.[/b]

➤ Lucky Coupon Spending Bonus Event
Period: After maintenance on May 27, 2025 –  June 03, 2025
[list]
[*] For every 3000 Gcoins, you get two Lucky Coupons. A total of 30 Lucky Coupons can be acquired.
[*] Rewards can be claimed in the "Event" tab.
[/list]
[b]■ Products
[/b]➤ Lucky Roulette modification

We want to thank each and every one of you for making N-Age Online: Awakening such a vibrant and unforgettable community. Your passion, dedication, and spirit are what keep this world alive and thriving. The adventure continues — and we can’t wait to share what’s next with you!

notes.title: Black Friday Mini Milestone GCoin Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/3380fe24c8b2bb1855b9f11b300d26d433fa730d.jpg[/img]

[b]Black Friday Mini Milestone GCoin Event[/b]

[b]Details:[/b]  Grab your rewards as you spend your Gcoins within the event period. 

[b]Promotion Period:[/b] November 21 – December 05

[b]Reward Insertion:[/b] A week after Maintenance

Mechanics: 
[list]
[*] Spend Gcoin to reach milestone rewards 
[*] Players can get all the items listed as long as they reach each level of the milestones.
[*] The accumulated amount of Gcoin will be rounded down to the nearest milestone (e.g., 29996 GC will only be eligible for the 20000 GC tier).
[*] 
[/list]•	After the promotion period, the rewards will be distributed and can be claimed at the player's item mall pick-up storage on the 29th of August.

[b]Note:[/b] Bonus Gcoins will not be included in the total Gcoins spent.
- Both Platforms can join. 
- Will only be available to players as a reward from the GCoin spending event.

[b]Reward List: [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/c7c7fcab85f64acdfa8b63626f96a2c26139c591.jpg[/img]


[b]Frequently Asked Questions: 
Question #1[/b]: If I spent 45,000 Gcoins without using Bonus Gcoin, what reward am I going to get? 
[b]Answer: [/b]Your Gcoin spent will be rounded down to the nearest tier reward which is Tier 4 40,000Gcoins. 
Since you reach Tier 4, You’ll receive the following: Tier 1 Reward, Tier 2 Reward, Tier 3 Reward, and Tier 4 Reward.

notes.title: Map Guides
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/4547d9f0e222aefc58171812b4bc5139cd133d4f.png[/img]

Welcome to the map of N-Age Online: Awakening, an expansive and diverse landscape filled with danger and wonder. Explore multiple Cities, battle monsters and bosses, and have an adventure of a life time! Get ready for an unforgettable adventure in this thrilling MMORPG.

[h1]Map Guides:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/7f8b09c925e5727d0937c085a1242719913fec06.png[/img]

[h2]The Four Cities[/h2]
[h3]Borbon City[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/eecc7b8de657042108f57c71f6073462e3313c7c.png[/img]
"Bourbon City" is the earliest town built among the five "basic life circles" in the N-age world.
The whole city is filled with a youthful atmosphere. The bustling streets and business districts everywhere make people raise their lips involuntarily, feeling the vitality and freedom of the city.
Not only that, but the residents here are kind and gentle. For novices who have just set foot in the new world, Bourbon City is a city that is very suitable as a starting point for adventure.
But in such a thriving town, there are also dark corners. The stronghold of the dark group is hidden in the depths of Bourbon City.
Long ago they drove the good people who lived in this place out of the city and took their dwellings for themselves.
As long as this dark groups is in Bourbon exists, there will be no real peace.
As a hero who embarks on a new world, I hope you will help Bourbon City usher in real peace with your strong will and strength!

[h3]Liberty Land[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/8de7aa9bea45f3c613902f29d19214040e6b9bd4.png[/img]
With a large number of towering modern buildings, clean, spacious streets and various large billboards, Liberty Land can be said to be both an economic center and the latest fashion hub.
"Liberty Land was originally a new town built brick by brick by the people of the Shanchuan tribe.
It is also said that these people who created the capital of freedom came from the distant city of Bourbon. Because their residence was occupied by greedy outsiders, they were forced to move here and reclaim their new homes.
However, in the hearts of the Shanchuan people, there is always a shadow of fear whispering: "If even the last city is taken away, where should we go?".
In order to defend their homeland, they urgently need the forces that can protect the city to join. Now we need your help full of justice and bravery!

[h3]Airbonne City[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/2e8e91398b322448facc18d22e1e474846bf1777.png[/img]
Airbonne is a beautiful coastal city. There are large and small cafes, parasols, and beautiful rows of coconut trees along the beach, attracting tourists like Miami's beautiful beaches.
The sunny and bright sun all year round makes this city with blue sea and blue sky reveal enthusiasm everywhere! But it is also the last military capital on the New World Continent with heavy troops stationed there.
There is NAPD in the city to maintain law and order, and outside the city there is also an exclusive army of Lotto City guarding it day and night to resist possible foreign enemies. There is such a high-security military force in order to guard against the "Tali Committee" that brought the new world to the brink of destruction.
For the sake of greed, they have launched many wars, turning the originally thriving basic life circle into a sea of flames overnight, millions of people were displaced, and countless people lost their lives.
The Tully Committee has coveted the prosperous and stable Lotto City for a long time, and often sneakily conducts shady incitement and espionage operations inside and outside the city. The tense atmosphere that is about to come makes the residents of Lotto City panic.
Airbonne City is in dire need of new heroes who are willing to step up and fight against the ambitious Tully Committee who are trying to pollute what is left of the quiet beauty!

[h3]Centerville City[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/57cbff080b907fc1f47e4cdf44e9c8ff86ad511c.png[/img]
Centerville City has a total area of 1,000 square kilometers. In terms of city area alone, Centerville City is the largest city in the reborn mainland.
It is an "electronic city" built according to urban engineering and managed by a supercomputer named "Lisa".
The biggest feature of Centerville City is its "solar energy development system". All the buildings in the city are equipped with solar panels on the surface, which provides a huge "solar energy" for the whole city, and can generate tens of millions of kilowatts of electricity every year. Therefore, Centerville City is also known as the "City of the Sun".
When rebuilding human civilization, with the backing of sufficient energy in Centerville City, human beings successfully built the existing four basic living circles and eight areas where people can live freely. Therefore, there is a saying that "losing Centerville City is equivalent to losing everything", This shows the value status of Centerville City in the hearts of the N-age generation.

[h2]Field Map[/h2]
[h3]Forgotten Forest[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b4e1825f42fdb8af1e557e86e12813a60c604839.png[/img]
Suggested level Lv.18 ~ 45
From Liberty Land, you must pass through Airbonne City, and the other side borders the deserted city.
The "Forgotten Forest" is inhabited by local aborigines. Because travelers often disturb their tranquility, they will sometimes actively attack people to defend their sovereignty.

[h3]Big Bear Valley[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/880f34e3adc46630cacb5f9a7f4a7cc7727b96a0.png[/img]
Suggested level Lv.18 ~ 45
Borbon City must pass through to Airbonn City, and the other side borders the deserted city.
The terrain of "Big Bear Canyon" is steep and extended, and if you are not careful, you will lose your way. It is recommended to turn on the GPS at any time to confirm your position when moving in this area.

[h3]Wasteland[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/ad9cece1d97c301da97874ddb85ef35445f920d4.png[/img]
Suggested level Lv.38 ~ 70
"Wasteland" is a product of the Fifth World War. Walking on the road, you can still see broken tiles and ruins of buildings that collapsed under the ruthless war.
The center of the map is the crystal cave. The monsters inside are very powerful, so don't approach it if you have nothing to do.

[h3]Centerville Park[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/49eff158526743de00e0fcc0884128ed3855554a.png[/img]
Suggested level Lv.28 ~ 50
Centerville Park" is located in Central City. The Tully Committee has developed various security robots in order to maintain the order of Centerville City, so that residents of Centerville City can live with peace of mind.

[h3]Abyss Cave I-II[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/677af1466779cb143f13c05ab6bd9814a7465be5.png[/img]
Recommended level Lv.45 ~ 89.
It is said that the underground water source in the Abyss Cave" is rich in energy, making the nearby elite monsters entrenched here for a long time.  2F of the cave also has a powerful boss, it's better not to approach if you don't bring enough supplements!

[h3]Lost City 1[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/9ba10c26cc1994dfafb4ebbe0414feba1d5b2da6.png[/img]
Lost City 1, 2F: Recommended level Lv.62 ~ 95
A city that's a victim of the Great War, the Lost City" is a history that has been completely erased.
As the most prosperous city in the continent, it is no longer remembered by people. It was isolated by the high wall of Central City, and now only forgotten residents are left wandering in the dark city.

[h3]Sodom I-II[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b734e2c7ace14e94b1c33876af47dfde9b4d6ee8.png[/img]
Sodom 1, 2, 3F: Recommended level Lv.88 ~ 99
"Sodom" is a city that cannot be found on the map, it is located underground in the Lost City. The alien races took advantage of the human war to build their own underground bunker here, the bunker is indestructible, and the BOSS is waiting for you in the deepest part.

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/e48a762b5008b2571e4985f2d3a2eb75c7f5f3de.png[/img]

[h3]Frequently Asked Questions:[/h3]

[b]Is N-Age Online: Awakening FREE to play?[/b]
Yes, N-Age Online: Awakening is a free to play game, like all other VALOFE games.

[b]How to Install?[/b]
[i][b]via Steam[/b][/i]
For installing N-Age Online: Awakening on Steam, adhere to the following steps:
[list]
[*] Log in to your Steam account.
[*] Search for N-Age Online: Awakening in the Steam store.
[*] Click the "Play Now" button.
[*] Choose the directory for installation.
[*] Wait for the process to finish.
[*] Finally, you can enjoy playing the game.
[/list]
[i][b]​​​​​​​via VFUN[/b][/i]
To install N-Age Online: Awakening on VFUN, perform the following steps:
[list]
[*] Visit the VFUN website and login.
[*] Download the VFUN launcher.
[*] Select the desired installation path.
[*] Once the launcher installation is complete, download N-Age Online: Awakening.
[*] Choose the installation path for the game.
[*] Wait for the installation process to finish.
[*] Finally, you can enjoy playing the game.
[/list]

[b]​​​​​​​What are the PC specifications for N-Age Online: Awakening?​​​​​​​[/b]
​​​​​​​For smooth playing experience, please check the following requirements:
[i][b]MINIMUM:[/b][/i]
OS: WinXP SP3, Win7(32-bit) SP1 and above
Processor: Pentium 3-800 or higher
Memory: 256 MB RAM
Graphics: GForce2 or Higher 3D Accelerator
DirectX: Version 8.1
Storage: 1 GB available space
Sound Card: Direct 8.1 or higher compatible card 
[b][i]RECOMMENDED:[/i][/b]
Processor: Pentium 4-1g or higher
Memory: 512 MB RAM
Graphics: GForce2 or Higher 3D Accelerator
DirectX: Version 8.1
Storage: 1 GB available space
Sound Card: Direct 8.1 or higher compatible card

[b]​​​​​​​I've never registered on this site, but the system says I'm registered. Why?[/b]
​​​​​​​Account IDs act as universal logins on the VFUN site, meaning that N-Age Online: Awakening shares the same login ID that you use for all other VFUN games. Please check to see if you are registered with any other VFUN games.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b9efa49c86165e361bf3d7c94447dcb5f6635e74.png[/img]
[list]
[*] If you’re unsure or have forgotten your ID and/or password, you can use the following steps to recover them.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/0dd4f1dfaee05720728c9781d406009cb5ab601e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Visit the VFUN website and click “Sign In”.
[*] You will find the “Find ID” and “Find Password” buttons.
[*] Provide the required information to proceed on the next step as indicated.
[/list]

[b]​​​​​​​I'm not able to connect the game from Steam.[/b]
[list]
[*] [i][b]​​​​​​​Investigate Firewalls[/b][/i]
[/list] There are specific firewalls that could impede Steam's communication with its servers. It is recommended that you collaborate with a specialist to ensure that the firewall is not creating any hindrance. For diagnostic purposes, you may need to disable it temporarily. In case you detect that it is the cause, you might have to add exceptions for Steam in your firewall.
[list]
[*] [i][b]Disable Overclocking[/b][/i]
[/list] Certain users may choose to overclock their hardware to enhance their system's performance, operating it beyond the manufacturer's recommended settings. However, this may result in memory and file corruption, and hence it is advisable to disable it (usually in the computer BIOS).

If you still have problems to use Steam continuously, please contact the Steam Customer Support.
>> https://help.steampowered.com/en/

notes.title: Beginner’s Guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/0daa06db0e6bc539ca53b5d2514f7991e7386409.png[/img]

Are you a newcomer to the N-age Young and Dangerous Life game? Or perhaps a seasoned player who's revisiting childhood memories after a gap of 10 years or more? Fret not, as we have created a beginner's guide to help you get started.

[h2]Beginner’s Quest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/6c290e330e7c549a64bcd00eb51ac98ad3b7d71c.png[/img]

Once the character creation process is finished, the character will spawn at the entrance of the nearby "Officetel".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/0ac6c7d4af88513ce93cb538945bf7872bd47e67.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/ee8d9ee44794e3256f11c4acf9ebe7c68361458f.png[/img]

You'll find the Officetel building closest to your location. Simply left-click on the door to enter it and speak with the NPC inside to receive the Beginner Quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/f4bd2365a51561dbd52b06689821d729b67d4c56.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/269a145bf99bf8fadcec60634e358e6621ec2e97.png[/img]

Once the dialogue box appears, click on the "Mission" button to accept the quest. Read through the basic guide and click on the "Next" button once you understand it. Once done, click on "Yes" to teleport automatically to the next quest location or "No" to travel there manually.

[h2]Convenience Store[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b01ebfa709c717da6029843d514cf49533f4900a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/69bdcedc1015b402baea8002d070b1007e169748.png[/img]


Enter the "Convenience Store" by left-clicking on the door and speak to the NPC. 

Click on the "Mission" button and read the "Convenience Store" guide before clicking on "Next". 

Complete the quest objectives and choose to teleport automatically by clicking "Yes", or manually travel to the next location by clicking "No". 

[h2]Weapon Shop [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/7fceebc51783f2728b25024071738bc0944add7b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/467afaa97ae1be78a3e1c8e36e3735694546241c.png[/img]

Go to the "Weapon Shop" and left-click on the door to enter. 

Speak to the NPC and click on the "Mission" button. 

Read the "Weapon Shop" guide carefully before clicking on "Next". 

After completing the quest objectives, choose to teleport automatically by clicking "Yes", or manually travel to the next location by clicking "No". 

[h2]Pharmacy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/4522287cfcf45ac81f5f9e04fbede212b22e0e3b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/7bdee4c7704b92c366f0e33b54b50486d66e3b35.png[/img]

Head to the "Pharmacy" and enter the building by left-clicking on the door. 

Speak with the NPC and click on the "Mission" button. 

Read and comprehend the "Pharmacy" guide before clicking on "Next". 

After completing the quest objectives, select "Yes" to teleport automatically to the next quest location, or "No" to go there manually.

[h2]Clothing Shop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/e7272a3132f976f7244e2ddd07d4264425e92718.png[/img]

Head to the "Clothing Shop" to complete the final quest. 

Talk to the NPC at the entrance and click on the "Mission" button. 

Read and understand the "Clothing Shop" guide before clicking on "Close". 

[b]NOTE: Keep in mind that completing each guided quest will provide you with helpful rewards, especially if you're new to the game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/a3682a2ca1d2bed59255261f442792015dc96d03.png[/img]

Upon completing the Beginner Quest, your character should now be at Level 4. 

Press the shortcut key "C" to check your character's level information and the experience required for the next level. 

To view your items in the inventory slot, press the "I" button and hover the mouse over the item to see its stat requirements. 

If an item's stats are marked in "red", it means that you do not have enough stat attribute to equip the item.

[h2]Leveling Up[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/597dc96162e274286cc844b5144bc0e7aea8ee60.png[/img]

Monsters are scattered all over the map, but before attacking them, it's highly recommended to check their levels. 

Checking the level of the monsters beforehand can help you determine if you're strong enough to defeat them. 

Successfully killing monsters will give you experience points, which can be viewed at the top left corner of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/0abe2766bbc5ef73fad45827ee64fb4143b645b5.png[/img]

To check your current experience, hover your mouse over the light blue bar in the "Status" bar, or press the (C) button. 

To pick up items dropped on the ground, simply click the left mouse button. 

Make sure to add HP consumables to your quick slot to avoid dying during battles.

[h2]Dying[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/ff0e516dd1e3023a3b4c4f5a21c37f06376fbbdf.png[/img]

When your character's HP reaches 0, you will be knocked out and unable to move or perform any action. 

To revive your character, press (F11) and click "Confirm". Your character will then be teleported to the nearest hospital or resurrection point. 

Note that dying will result in an automatic 5% reduction in your current experience points as a penalty. 

Alternatively, if you choose to use an item to resurrect, 10% of your money in the inventory will be deducted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/b325dd20f4e8f934739e86e7bc291c704ed089cb.png[/img]

Reviving at the hospital will restore your character's HP to 1/4 of its maximum value. 

To fully heal your character, talk to the nurse inside the hospital. 

The nurse will provide healing services for a fee, which will vary depending on your character's level and the amount of HP needed to be restored. 

[h2]Teaming Up[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42178738/50e7b4418249083f6d048d9ea672608007bece3e.png[/img]

When your character reaches Level 5, return to the "Officetel" to start the quest for forming a party. 

Invited players will receive a confirmation dialogue to accept or decline the invitation. 

Upon confirmation, a party will be created and the quest will be completed. 

It's suggested to level up with friends to earn full experience points and gain experience when teammates defeat nearby monsters.
